title: Make it a skill
caption: Hands-on 2: turn your good run into a quiz skill, then prove it on a second article.

steps.first: Step “Write the skill”: copy the prompt into the chat of your good run; the AI writes what it learned as a skill.
steps.second: Save the skill where your AI can use it, as the Workflow shows for your tool.
steps.third: Step “Try the skill”: give it a second article and nothing else.
steps.fourth: Compare the two quizzes: what does the skill still miss?

done: A second quiz page, made in one step from your skill.

workflow.label: Open the quiz Workflow
workflow.pick: On the page, pick “Turn a source into a quiz”. Each step there has the prompt to copy, in a chat version and one for an agent.

help.label: Where you're stuck
help.placeholder: Paste what the AI answered, or describe where you're stuck…
help.copyTip: Paste this prompt into an AI you are allowed to use.
help.noError: (I haven't pasted anything yet: ask me what I see.)

help.step: Stage 3, Improve: Write the skill, then Try the skill

talking-points.description: The red thread lands here: the run by hand took an afternoon, the skill takes one step. Anyone without a second article takes the fallback source from the Workflow.
